what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1967?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1967 annual town report prints no wage list: its text (140 pages) was searched for wage, wages, salaries paid and payroll and found only the proposed salary schedule (p45), salary lines of the voted budget (p71-72) and the accountant's schedule (p27-38), none by person. — closes: the Town's 1967 payroll register or the Treasurer's payments by employee.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1967, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1967 report prints year-end balances as lines of the balance sheet (p16-17) and the school's federal and revolving accounts (p130-136), but no town-wide fund schedule of forward, receipts and disbursements (searched revolving, special revenue, fund, receipts reserved). — closes: the Accountant's 1967 fund ledger by fund.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1967?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1967 report lists each special article's appropriation, expenditure and balance carried inside the accountant's schedule (p27-38) and the Middle School financing (p42, p68), with no separate capital fund schedule. — closes: the Accountant's 1967 capital projects ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for 1967?
why: `report-valuation` holds the valuation and levy history from the 1987-2010 reports. The 1967 report prints the assessed valuation as two lines of the opening facts page (p5: real estate $11,523,290, personal property $1,060,955, tax rate $94.50), the committed taxes in the Tax Collector's report (p18), and the overlay only as a reserve (p17: `Overlay Reserved for Abatements(1967) 2,807.14`); no recapitulation of levy, overlay or growth (searched valuation, overlay, tax rate, levy, growth across all pages). — closes: the Assessors' 1967 tax rate recapitulation filed with the State.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1967, and what did sealing bring in by device type?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and `sealing-fee-schedule` the fee per device from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1967 report gives the year's totals in prose (PDF p54: 156 weighing devices inspected, 151 correct and sealed, 3 pumps and 2 scales condemned) and one receipts line, `Inspector of Weights and Measures 261.80` (p21), with no count or fee by device type. — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1967 test and fee record.
